The '''Lambda-C''' was a model of [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]]. The [[Mu-class shuttle/Legends|''Mu''-class shuttle]] was a modified Lambda-C.
